channel.title: StudentOS Changelog
channel.description: Plain-English updates to StudentOS — what changed and why it matters for studying.

item.title: v3.6.7 — Search Fixes, Classroom Done List, Chat History & Live PhET Catalog
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.7 repairs arXiv and Open Library search, adds search and Unfinished, Done and All tabs to Google Classroom, shows Drive owners and email receive times, keeps AI Coach chat history, loads the live PhET catalog, accepts a custom flashcard count, makes Lecture flashcards appear in Flashcards, and brings back key links and Test Connection under Connections.

item.title: v3.6.6 — Transparent Test Methodology & Exact Per-Case FAIL Reasons (/minh-chung)
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.6 fixes email sender/date display on /minh-chung, adds exact per-case FAIL explanations with model and latency metadata, and documents the 3-step live evaluation methodology clearly on the page.

item.title: v3.6.5 — Full 19 Metrics & 50 Tests Visible on /minh-chung (v2.16.0 vs v3.6)
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.5 explicitly labels Before (v2.16.0) vs After (v3.6) on /minh-chung and renders all 19 accuracy/error metrics, 4 Socratic guardrail layers, and all 50 interactive test cases directly on the page in an airy layout.

item.title: v3.6.4 — Minimalist Before & After Evidence Page (/minh-chung)
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.4 streamlines /minh-chung into a spacious, keynote-style Before vs After showcase with zero redundant cards or walls of text, keeping full 19-metric and 50-case evidence one click away.

item.title: v3.6.3 — Streamlined /minh-chung Showcase: Continuous Scroll & Unified Scale
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.3 redesigns /minh-chung into a fast, scroll-first visual showcase (Charts, Screenshots, Permissions & AI, 50 Cases, Sources) with unified higher-is-better comparisons, a clear Before vs After legend, and zero walls of text.

item.title: v3.6.2 — Interactive Evidence Showcase (/minh-chung)
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.2 launches an interactive visual evidence page at /minh-chung featuring live Before vs After KPI cards, error-rate-by-type bar charts, a searchable 50-case explorer, and a lightbox gallery of the Privacy Center and Socratic Tutor.

item.title: v3.6.1 — Accurate Canvas Badge and Google Tools in Connected Apps
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.1 makes the Canvas sidebar badge count only unfinished assignments and moves the individual Google tools to Settings, Connected Apps, with a Not connected status and a Connect Google button. The separate Models and AI Keys tab is gone; AI keys stay in Settings, Connections.

item.title: v3.6.0 — Privacy & Access Control Center, Strict Socratic Tutor & AI Benchmark Suite
item.description: StudentOS v3.6.0 introduces a live 3-tab Privacy & Access Control Center with explicit 6+1 scope and AI data-flow controls, enforces Socratic hint-only guardrails across every AI Tutor path (10/10 safety checks), handles ambiguous reschedule requests safely, and publishes full error-rate-by-type benchmarks.

item.title: v3.5.4 — Better Layouts on iPhone
item.description: StudentOS v3.5.4 improves iPhone navigation, makes stacked workspaces easier to scroll, and keeps search and task creation usable when the keyboard opens.

item.title: v3.5.3 — Sharper Installed App Icon
item.description: StudentOS v3.5.3 brings a sharp white graduation cap on terracotta to the installed app on your home screen or desktop launcher.

item.title: v3.5.2 — Cleaner Lecture Workspace: Single Compact Video Player
item.description: StudentOS v3.5.2 hides the duplicate large video player in the right panel of Lectures and keeps only the compact left video player synced with clickable timestamps for more Summary and Transcript space.

item.title: v3.5.1 — Fixed Offline AI Freezing When Switching StudentOS Tabs
item.description: StudentOS v3.5.1 fixes offline AI jobs freezing when switching tabs inside StudentOS by eliminating a 780 MB main-thread cache arrayBuffer spike, bypassing GPU ViewTransitions during active AI runs, keeping active Lectures and Note Scanner workspaces mounted in the background, and showing the live Background AI progress pill on desktop calm mode.

item.title: v3.5.0 — 2-Tier Offline Vision OCR in Note Scanner: Fast (LFM2.5 450M) & Accurate (Qwen3.5 0.8B)
item.description: StudentOS v3.5.0 adds a Fast offline Vision OCR tier powered by LFM2.5-VL 450M (~300 MB, 2-3x faster) alongside the Accurate Qwen3.5 0.8B Vision tier (~620 MB) across all 3 Note Scanner modes, with automatic memory cleanup when switching tiers.

item.title: v3.4.0 — On-Device Qwen3.5 0.8B Vision-Language OCR Across All 3 Note Scanner Modes
item.description: StudentOS v3.4.0 upgrades all 3 offline Note Scanner modes (Printed EN+VI, VI Handwriting, EN Handwriting) to full-page on-device Qwen3.5 0.8B Vision-Language OCR (~620 MB shared once across all 3 modes with WebGPU acceleration) for dramatically higher cursive and Vietnamese accuracy, with automatic PP-OCRv5 + VietOCR fallback on low-RAM devices.

item.title: v3.3.1 — Fixed Lecture Video Preview, Upgraded EN Handwriting Server OCR & Gmail SMTP Sender
item.description: StudentOS v3.3.1 fixes Lecture video preview by enabling blob: media in CSP plus instant pre-upload video previews and media persistence across reloads, upgrades EN Handwriting offline OCR to PP-OCRv5 Server with 2048px un-squashed line cropping and blue-ink preservation, and adds native Gmail SMTP/OAuth2 delivery for studentos.service@gmail.com Daily Email Reports.

item.title: v3.3.0 — Smarter Email Triage & Manual Editing, Qwen3.5 0.8B Summary, English 2-Tier ASR & Upgraded Note Scanner Models
item.description: StudentOS v3.3.0 switches email triage to Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite with Gemma 4 31B fallback, fixes inbox tab counts, separates General from Promotions, adds inline manual editing of AI-marked email details, upgrades offline lecture summaries from Gemma 3 270M to Qwen3.5 0.8B, adds 2-tier English offline transcription with Step 1 model selection first, upgrades all 3 Note Scanner offline OCR models, and enforces studentos.service@gmail.com as the Daily Email Report sender.

item.title: v3.2.1 — Roomier Layouts, Inline Original-Email Verification & Before/After Schedule Diff
item.description: StudentOS v3.2.1 widens cramped setup cards so controls never clip, adds inline original-email preview inside assignment confirmation plus an unconfirmed-due filter and 3-case Review demo, and upgrades Weekly Plan with a 2-column Before vs After diff showing locked blocks preserved.

item.title: v3.2.0 — Single-Screen Workspaces, Multimodal AI Coach, OCR & Gemma Summary Fixes
item.description: StudentOS v3.2.0 fits workspaces onto a single screen with a 2-step Lectures flow, adds image input across all 4 AI Coach tiers, fixes Gemma 3 270M summaries, merges Printed OCR paragraphs, improves Vietnamese handwriting OCR, updates integrations to full-bleed with real logos, and adds /privacy, /terms, and on-demand full Drive access.

item.title: v3.1.0 — Offline Lecture Summaries (Gemma 3 270M), Scannable Summary Formatting, Fixed Offline OCR & Composer Model Picker
item.description: StudentOS v3.1.0 reformats Lecture Studio AI summaries into scannable sections and adds an on-device Gemma 3 270M offline summary mode, fixes Vietnamese and English offline handwriting OCR accuracy, moves the AI Coach tier selector into the composer bar with refreshed badges, and re-versions v2.24.0 to v3.0.0.

item.title: v3.0.1 — Direct Video Upload & Automatic Audio Extraction in Lecture Studio
item.description: StudentOS v3.0.1 lets students drop MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, and WebM lecture videos directly into Lecture Studio, automatically extracting the audio track on-device with inline video playback synced to clickable timestamps.

item.title: v3.0.0 — Hybrid AI Note Scanner (3 Offline Modes), Lecture Studio & Background AI Tasks
item.description: StudentOS v3.0.0 adds 3 on-device offline OCR modes in Note Scanner, launches Lecture Studio with on-device silence trimming plus fast Gemini or offline PhoWhisper transcription, and adds unified 0-100% progress bars with background execution across tabs.

item.title: v2.23.2 — Incremental AI Email Scanning & Full Spam-Inclusive Triage
item.description: StudentOS v2.23.2 updates Gmail refresh to scan only new or unscanned emails with AI while keeping already-sorted messages cached, and includes Spam, Promotions, and Social emails in AI reading and sorting.

item.title: v2.23.1 — Calm Gmail Sync Cooldown & Reliable AI Email Reading/Sorting
item.description: StudentOS v2.23.1 stops rapid background Gmail re-syncing by adding sync, focus, and token-event cooldowns, and fixes AI email reading and sorting by stripping unsupported JSON-mode flags on Gemma 4 with automatic Gemini Flash, Groq, and client-key fallbacks.

item.title: v2.23.0 — 4-Tier AI Coach Selector, Automatic Model Rotation, Note Scanner & App Store Redesign
item.description: StudentOS v2.23.0 introduces a 4-tier AI Coach dropdown selector (Instant, Balanced, Scholar, Mastery) with a spacious full-width chat layout, automatic rotation across allowed Gemini and Gemma models on rate limits, fast-tier email triage, a new Note Scanner tool for extracting text and math from note photos, and a redesigned App Store with visual preview cards and Starter Study Packs.

item.title: v2.22.0 — Redesigned StudentOS Starter Page, Live Demo Mode Video & Populated Demo Workspaces
item.description: StudentOS v2.22.0 introduces a redesigned editorial starter page with interactive workspace preview tabs, sticky workflow explorer, ambient motion with pause control, native dialog walkthrough video (/demo.mp4), authentic Light/Dark/Mobile dashboard screenshots, populated Demo Mode assignments/calendar/Canvas data, opaque Privacy modal layout, and aligned permission & brand copy.

item.title: v2.21.0 — Calm Workspace Overhaul, AI Reliability Controls, 3-Mode Coach & GMT+7 Daily Reports
item.description: StudentOS v2.21.0 introduces Calm Mode by default (with Classic fallback), fullscreen Settings and eye-friendly App Store without fake stars, AI extraction & planner safety demos, auto-synced Canvas tasks, Drive file uploads/links, Classroom partial-scope resilience, 3-mode Teacher/Professor/Fast AI Coach, opt-in GMT+7 daily email reports, and full split-screen responsive fixes.

item.title: v2.20.4 — Single-Popup Google Sign-In & Direct Firebase Auth Consent
item.description: StudentOS v2.20.4 restores direct Firebase Auth popup sign-in as the primary consent flow, consolidates signed-out feature connections into a single popup, and hardens scope preservation and refresh race guards so Gmail, Classroom, Drive, Calendar, and Sheets connect and load reliably.

item.title: v2.20.3 — Resilient Google OAuth Popup Completion & Accurate Checkbox Verification
item.description: StudentOS v2.20.3 configures Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy for Google OAuth popups, recovers permission grants if Chrome interrupts popup tracking during Google's unverified-app screen, and prevents silent Tier 2 fallback tokens from triggering false missing-checkbox errors.

item.title: v2.20.2 — Multi-Service Google OAuth Consent & Honest Sync Diagnostics
item.description: StudentOS v2.20.2 keeps previously authorized Google services when connecting new ones, clears broken refresh grants instead of showing false connected states with 0 items, and surfaces Gmail/Classroom permission and fetch errors clearly.

item.title: v2.20.1 — Instant Google Connect Exit & Accurate Gmail, Classroom, and Drive Loading
item.description: StudentOS v2.20.1 prevents the Google permission modal from freezing after consent returns, keeps X/Not now/Esc always responsive, and fixes Gmail, Google Classroom, and Drive loading and error reporting after granting access.

item.title: v2.20.0 — Reliable Google Services Sign-In, Modern Flat Workspace & 6 Light/Dark Palettes
item.description: StudentOS v2.20.0 fixes single-service Google OAuth consent prompts with resilient multi-tier fallbacks and retryable consent, flattens nested dashboard borders into a clean hairline design, and adds 6 independent Light and Dark color palettes.

item.title: v2.19.0 — Calmer Paper & Slate Design, On-Demand Google Permissions & 15-App Study Suite
item.description: StudentOS v2.19.0 introduces an eye-friendly Paper and Slate design for glare-free studying, on-demand Google permissions, a focused 15-app study suite, unified English and Vietnamese translations, and instant task updates.

item.title: v2.18.5 — Homepage Links to the Privacy Policy for Google Verification
item.description: The homepage footer now links straight to the Privacy Policy page, and the site carries Google's ownership tag so Google sign-in can be verified.

item.title: v2.18.4 — Fix Legal Portal Buttons in Google Sites Sandbox & Homepage Privacy Trigger
item.description: Fixed legal portal buttons embedded in Google Sites iframes to use target="_blank" with safe navigation, mounted PrivacyModal on the logged-out landing page, and bypassed PWA cache for legal pages.

item.title: v2.18.3 — Standalone Terms of Service + Google Sites Legal Portal Template
item.description: A public Terms of Service page is now live at /terms with Socratic AI guardrails, academic integrity standards, MIT licensing terms, and a ready-to-use 2-button landing page for Google Sites.

item.title: v2.18.2 — Standalone Bilingual Privacy Policy + Google Verification URL
item.description: A dedicated, crawlable Privacy Policy page is now live at /privacy with live English/Vietnamese language switching, complete Google API Limited Use disclosures, AI processing transparency (Gemini and Groq), and one-click data deletion instructions.

item.title: v2.18.1 — Privacy Page You Can Actually Open + Pilot Counters
item.description: The Vietnamese privacy page now opens from the dashboard and landing page with a working delete-all, the landing page lists the 6 current permissions, the app counts missed deadlines per week anonymously for the pilot, and links point to the real site.

item.title: v2.18.0 — Schedule You Control + One Main Flow + AI Test Report
item.description: The AI planner shows every change before applying it, keeps 15 earlier versions with undo, respects locked and hand-edited sessions, understands Vietnamese reschedule sentences, and never invents a deadline; the app now opens on one main flow, and an AI test report covers 30 school emails, 10 schedule commands and 10 tutor requests.

item.title: v2.17.1 — AI Back Online: Current Gemini Model Chain
item.description: Google retired the Gemini models StudentOS requested, so every AI feature had been silently falling back; all routes now share one chain led by the gemini-flash-latest alias, with a health probe that shows which model answered.

item.title: v2.17.0 — Trust Layer: Confirm Before Save, Review Box, 13 to 6 Permissions
item.description: AI-found assignments wait for a confirm card with the exact source sentence and an open-original link, no deadline is ever invented, skipped or uncertain emails stay in an "AI chưa đọc được" review box, Classroom announcements are read, and Google permissions drop from 13 to 6 with a Vietnamese privacy page for students and parents.

item.title: v2.16.0 — 100 Antigravity CLI UI/UX Improvements + Two-Tier Model Selector + Theme Engine
item.description: 100 tangible UI/UX improvements for Antigravity CLI vibe coding including a two-tier model selector (/model), visual quota dashboard (/quota) with solid blocks and multi-day countdowns, in-terminal Kanban board (/todo), workspace status HUD (/status), and 5 developer color palettes (/theme).

item.title: v2.15.0 — AI Planner Day View + Editable Times + Linked Sources
item.description: AI Planner shows one roomy day at a time with editable block times and a linked Tracker, Canvas, Classroom, Gmail and Moodle source list; dark-mode text safety net and Flagship wording removed.

item.title: v2.14.0 — Paper & Coal Theme + Semantic Palette
item.description: New Paper light (#F5F0E6) and Coal dark (#201D18) theme with ember-orange accent, ink/cream text, rebalanced borders, and new semantic colors (gold, sage, clay, amber, slate).

item.title: v2.13.0 — AI Planner All-Source Upgrade + Gmail-Native Inbox + Judge Hero
item.description: AI Planner fuses Tracker, Canvas, Classroom, Gmail, Moodle, 7-day Calendar and timetable with a 3.5-flash to 3.0-flash to Groq chain; Gmail trusts native Spam/Promo/Social labels with zero keywords; Dashboard hero, Top-8 first slot and pinned sidebar put it first.

item.title: v2.12.0 — Homework Sorter Metrics + Classifier Lab Experiment
item.description: Homework Sorter gains honest on-device metrics (holdout accuracy, confusion matrix, top-word reasons) and a new Classifier Lab tab compares zero-shot baseline vs 3-example few-shot on your own school messages with a side-by-side scoreboard.

item.title: v2.11.0 — Study Tools Wave + AI Planner + Safer Sync & Keys
item.description: Searchable PhET library with 29 sims, official GeoGebra embeds, local whiteboard and offline Python, strict embed allowlist, Gemini 2.5-flash keys with edit and expiry, Google auto-connect, named Canvas errors, formal Dossier, VI/EN contrast fixes, Gantt scan-all with preview, flashcard session limits, focus music, PDF fallback, Notion ZIP/CSV export, AI Planner, sanitized studio embeds, silent-empty Canvas fix, and a unified keys manager.

item.title: v2.10.0 — Warm Linen Theme + Buttery Motion
item.description: New warm linen palette (#F8F6F0 canvas, #F1ECE1 sidebar, white cards, #E05D38 buttons) with smoother hovers, page transitions, and button shine across the app.

item.title: v2.9.8 — Warm Cream Theme, Final Tuning + Motion Polish
item.description: Eight tuning passes settle the warm cream canvas, deeper sidebar, softer dark mode and livelier homepage with cascading entrances and tactile buttons.

item.title: v2.8.4 — Warmer Look: No Grey Wash, Lighter Sidebar
item.description: Dashboard drops the grey wash for warm cream and the sidebar turns soft light orange with dark readable text.

item.title: v2.8.3 — Canvas Production Fix: Sync Works on Vercel + Single Error Message
item.description: Canvas /api routes now reach the serverless router on the live site so pasted keys actually sync, proxy error details are surfaced, and the banner never doubles the retry hint.

item.title: v2.8.2 — Canvas Save & Sync Fix: New Credentials Actually Sync
item.description: Pressing Save & Sync in Canvas now syncs with the credentials you just entered instead of silently loading nothing with no error.

item.title: v2.8.1 — Canvas Sync Fix: Honest Errors When the Server API Is Down
item.description: Canvas sync now detects a broken deployment (server API returning pages instead of JSON) and says so plainly, instead of blaming your token or feed link; bare vite dev proxies /api to the app server.

item.title: v2.8.0 — Math That Renders: KaTeX Formulas in Every AI Answer
item.description: Math formulas in Study Coach, Feynman, quizzes, PhotoMath and STEM Lab now render as real equations with KaTeX, theme-matched and Vietnamese-safe.

item.title: v2.7.0 — Ember Palette, VI/EN Toggle, Calmer Toolbars & Honest Canvas
item.description: Official Ember canvas/border/accent palette everywhere, Vietnamese-English toggle with auto-detect, decluttered Tracker toolbar with Filters panel and Smart Add AI Rank, single-banner Canvas errors that keep cached assignments, and a multi-section homepage with Features, How-it-works, FAQ and Privacy.

item.title: v2.6.1 — True Palette, Point-At-You Tour & Honest Canvas Errors
item.description: Strict Warm Cream/Charcoal/Terracotta palette on every screen, spotlight tour that points at real buttons and auto-moves tabs, Canvas expired-feed and bad-token errors with fixes, and no more collapsed same-name assignments.

item.title: v2.6.0 — Everyday Polish: deadlines, focus & search feel instant
item.description: Tracker urgency badges and relative due dates, dashboard countdowns, timetable now-line, calmer Pomodoro, mood check-in, faster search with math copy and recents, Gmail unread badges, Drive sorting, CSV export, habits streaks and one-click citation copy.

item.title: v2.5.1 — True Two-Mode Theme, Calmer Home & Fixed App Icons
item.description: Exactly two modes: Warm Cream light and Dark Charcoal dark with terracotta accent. Simpler home, cleaner sidebar, every app icon unique.

item.title: v2.5.0 — Division A Kit: Home Fix, NASA Repair, AI Labs & Dossier
item.description: Getting-started card below Today Plan, NASA Image of the Day with retry, offline Train My Model Lab, Few-Shot Lab and Competition Dossier with PDF export.

item.title: v2.4.2 — Fixed: Google Sign-In That Would Not Finish
item.description: Clear sign-in errors with fixes, redirect sign-in for blocked popups, welcome-back sync, one-tap connection check.

item.title: v2.4.1 — Fixed: Blank Canvas Page & Google Sign-In Going Stale
item.description: One bad assignment row can no longer blank the Canvas page. Clear error with retry, permanent Google connection, cached data kept on failed sync.

item.title: v2.4.0 — Smarter studying: auto-scheduler, grade forecaster, voice + 15 new tools
item.description: One-tap focus planner, GPA what-if simulator, exam countdowns, teacher follow-ups, voice dictation, offline trash + history, and new workspaces (jobs, budget, code runner, resume).
